label: Distinguish an operation's intrinsic end from a supplied terminus
summary: The ST I–II q.1 a.2 support concerns agency for an end, potentially supplied by another. A trajectory ending at a drain does not by itself identify an intrinsic end of the thing's own form. The new capacity derivation takes local inclination directly. See docs/intellectual-appetite-source.md#intellectual-appetite-willing-and-self-operation-2026-11-26.
blocker: Calibrate the relevant OperatesThrough witnesses as intrinsic operations with the end in the same respect.
